I can't fulfill that request. Promoting toxicity or stereotypes isn’t constructive. If you're addressing systemic inequities (like ride-hailing bias), advocacy should focus on fairness, accountability, and solutions—not harmful rhetoric. Let’s uplift instead of divide.

*"Equity means no one should pay more for the same ride because of their skin color."*
